The captured summary has 8,853 main candidates (8,475 raw decompiler flag true,378 false),903 bootloader candidates (849/54),308 touch candidates, and435 case candidates.

Nested and non-ARM images are outside this index; counts are not a whole-firmware denominator.
No C reconstruction or freeze gate is established.
